architecturePatterns.requiredImports: function validateImports(fileContent) { const requiredImports = ['React', 'useState', 'useEffect']; return requiredImports.every(importName => fileContent.includes(importName)); }
architecturePatterns.fileStructure: function validateFileStructure(filePath) { const validStructure = /src\/components\/\w+\.tsx$/; return validStructure.test(filePath); }

integrationValidation.apiContractValidation: function validateApiContract(apiResponse) { const expectedKeys = ['status', 'data']; return expectedKeys.every(key => key in apiResponse); }
integrationValidation.databaseSchemaChecks: function validateDatabaseSchema(schema) { const requiredFields = ['id', 'name', 'email']; return requiredFields.every(field => field in schema); }
integrationValidation.componentInterfaceValidation: function validateComponentInterface(componentProps) { const requiredProps = ['title', 'onSubmit']; return requiredProps.every(prop => prop in componentProps); }

qualityThresholds.complexityLimits: function validateComplexity(fileContent) { const maxLines = 200; return fileContent.split('\n').length <= maxLines; }
qualityThresholds.performanceThresholds: function validatePerformance(fileContent) { const maxApiCalls = 5; const apiCallCount = (fileContent.match(/fetch\(/g) || []).length; return apiCallCount <= maxApiCalls; }
qualityThresholds.securityScoreMinimums: function validateSecurityScore(securityScore) { const minScore = 80; return securityScore >= minScore; }
qualityThresholds.architectureCompliancePercentages: function validateArchitectureCompliance(complianceScore) { const minCompliance = 90; return complianceScore >= minCompliance; }
